$comment: Provenance of this native fork; scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs reads it. The only delta stores each Session's assembled request-header tool catalog once and writes a digest reference on every later request that repeats it, rehydrated inline by every read; the header line carries a marker so a harness without this fork refuses the artifact instead of reading a reference as an empty tool list. Every other physical format, migration, lock and write path is upstream byte-for-byte.
